description: This file defines the class LazyValueResourceElementWrapper, which is a wrapper for Android resource elements in the IntelliJ IDEA plugin environment. It provides methods for resource name retrieval, renaming, presentation, and comparison, integrating with IntelliJ's PSI and virtual file systems.

classes.name: LazyValueResourceElementWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper class for Android resource elements in IntelliJ IDEA, providing resource management, presentation, and comparison functionalities.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the resource.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets a new name for the resource, throws IncorrectOperationException if unable.

methods.name: getPresentation
methods.description: Provides a presentation object for UI display, including text and icon.

methods.name: computeElement
methods.description: Computes and returns the XML attribute value representing the resource.

methods.name: getNavigationElement
methods.description: Returns the PSI element for navigation, defaulting to the XML element or parent.

methods.name: getTypeName
methods.description: Returns the type name 'Android Value Resource'.

methods.name: getIcon
methods.description: Returns null, placeholder for icon representation.

methods.name: computeLazyElement
methods.description: Static method to compute the XML element if the input is a LazyValueResourceElementWrapper.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this wrapper with another based on resource info for sorting.
